description: The text of one question or part from an exam.now past paper: context, prompt, marks, figures (with alt text), the answer surface (response kinds, tools, whether a calculator is allowed), topic codes and a link to the part on exam.now. answer.onSite is true when the part needs a graph or drawing, so it can only be answered on exam.now; otherwise the student can type the answer in chat and mark_answer marks it. Pass question for the whole question or part for one part.

include_images.description: Attach small figures as image content as well as URLs.

paper_id.description: exam.now paper id from find_past_paper, e.g. 0580_s24_42 (syllabus code, series letter s/w/m and two-digit year, component).

part.description: Part id as the paper numbers it, e.g. "3", "3(a)" or "3(a)(i)".

name: get_question
title: Get a question
